title: Fixed Caged Hoop Return Station
description: One newly authored complete static arcade hoop-return station. Four grounded shoes and an open tied leg frame support one continuous rear-high to front-low return surface and a flat receiving bay. Two full side catch cages with sloping front rails, actual spaced bars and upper crossmembers rise into a rear backboard integrated with the same frame. A real open upper hoop, sparse closed basket strands and an open lower ring hang above the return floor; one static ball rests in the front receiving bay. All whole geometry is new, not a freestanding basketball stand arranged beside a previous lane, a hole-target table with its printed scoring changed, or the existing upward-curved roll-launch cabinet fitted with a new target. Three opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, native Z up and whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One complete prop, zero scenes. Static unoccupied visual only: no electronics, actual scoring, ball simulation, guaranteed return route or containment, playable game, human fit, impact resistance, loading, manufacture or safety claim.
